plan: Model the session as a single authoritative dictionary with exactly the four contract keys, reset via one _initial_session factory used by __init__, begin, and abandon.
Copy the appointments sequence into an internal ordered list at construction and precompute the set of known ids for validation.
Implement handle as a guarded dispatcher: validate the action shape and per-type payload first, mutate the session only after all checks pass, and route every response through one screen builder.
Centralize presentation in a _screen builder that emits a fresh {prompt, messages, choices} dictionary each call, attaching appointment choices exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.
Render invalid actions with an _error helper that derives the prompt from the current (unchanged) session and prefixes the first message with 'Error:', never raising.

Inject action_source and screen_sink through the constructor; run_once raises RuntimeError before touching either port when one is missing, then reads one action, handles it, displays the screen exactly once, and returns the same screen object so unittest fakes can drive and observe the console.
mechanisms: Authoritative session dictionary mutated only after full validation (commit-last handlers)
Pure screen-builder producing fresh prompt/messages/choices structures per call
Per-action-type guarded dispatcher with malformed-input checks that cannot raise
Error screens rendered from unchanged state with 'Error:'-prefixed first message
run_once mediator with precondition RuntimeError and single display of the returned screen
